core_obligations: Choose the presentation square with U, V schemes and a, b etale and lift the geometric point xbar to ubar over u (proof lines 6178-6191).
Identify O_{X,xbar} with the strict henselization of O_{U,u} and O_{Y,ybar} with that of O_{V,v}, obtaining the square of local rings with flat horizontal arrows (proof lines 6192-6209).
Reduce the claim to the equivalence between flatness of the left and of the right vertical arrow (proof lines 6210-6211).
Apply the flatness descent lemma and the up-and-down property of henselization to conclude (proof lines 6212-6216).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and a geometric point xbar of X over x with image ybar, flatness of f at x is equivalent to flatness of the ring map O_{Y,ybar} -> O_{X,xbar} between etale local rings (source lines 6162-6175). The proof chooses a presentation diagram U -> V over X -> Y with etale a, b, lifts xbar to a geometric point ubar of U, identifies the two etale local rings with the strict henselizations of the local rings O_{U,u} and O_{V,v}, compares the two vertical arrows in the resulting square of local rings via the flatness descent lemma, and finishes with the flat up-and-down property of henselization.
